en_title: Game of Thrones Star Kit Harington Isn't a Gamer, But He's Excited for Grand Theft Auto 6
cn_title: 《侠盗猎车手》《权力的游戏》演员想玩《GTA6》
subtitle: 不常玩，也想试试
opus_summary: 《权力的游戏》演员Kit Harington说自己不太玩游戏，但看过宣传内容后想玩《GTA6》。他曾玩过《霍格沃茨之遗》等游戏，尚未表示最终是否会玩这款新作。

paragraphs.en: Game of Thrones star Kit Harington has confessed that he isn't much of a gamer, but wants to play Grand Theft Auto 6 .
paragraphs.cn: 《权力的游戏》演员基特·哈灵顿坦言，自己不太玩游戏，但想玩《GTA6》。

paragraphs.en: The actor best known for playing Jon Snow reflected on his experience with the gaming world with Josh Horowitz in a recent interview . After recalling his experience working on Silent Hill: Revelation, a live-action film based on the beloved horror gaming franchise, he was asked if he was much of a gamer. Harington noted he didn't have much experience with the Silent Hill games, but played a bit of Tekken, Mario Kart, Diddy Kong Racing, and most recently, Hogwarts Legacy.
paragraphs.cn: 基特·哈灵顿因饰演琼恩·雪诺而为人熟知。最近接受Josh Horowitz采访时，他谈起了自己与游戏的交集。回忆完参演《寂静岭：Revelation》这部改编自人气恐怖游戏系列的真人电影的经历后，他被问到是否经常玩游戏。Harington说，自己没怎么玩过《寂静岭》系列，但玩过一点《铁拳》《马力欧卡丁车》和《迪迪刚赛车》；最近还玩了《霍格沃茨之遗》。

paragraphs.en: When Horowitz asked if he'd ever dabbled in Grand Theft Auto, Harington said that he wants to play Grand Theft Auto 6 after seeing some of the advertising. He went on to express an admiration for videos that mimic GTA's tropes in real life. All of this sort of goes to show that the GTA 6 effect is beginning to happen, as even non-gamers are getting pulled in by its trance.
paragraphs.cn: Horowitz问他有没有玩过《侠盗猎车手》时，Harington说自己看了一些宣传内容后想玩《GTA6》。他还表示，自己很喜欢那些在现实生活中模仿《GTA》经典桥段的视频。这似乎表明，《GTA6》的影响力已经开始显现：就连不常玩游戏的人也被它吸引了。

paragraphs.en: Rockstar is spending a boatload of cash to get the game in front of as many people as possible. It has assembled an Avengers-level ensemble of musicians to craft an original soundtrack for Grand Theft Auto 6, spent nearly $1 million on a "Welcome to Vice City" sign in Miami , and is likely only going to continue to ramp things up as we get closer to launch. NBA star Steven Adams also joked that he expects the performance of the league to drop when GTA 6 releases in November.
paragraphs.cn: Rockstar正投入大笔资金，力求让尽可能多的人看到这款游戏。它集结了堪称「复仇者联盟级别」的音乐人阵容，为《GTA6》创作原创配乐，还在迈阿密花了近100万美元(约合人民币671万元)制作一块「欢迎来到罪恶都市」的标牌。随着发售日临近，Rockstar可能还会加大宣传力度。NBA球星Steven Adams也开玩笑说，他预计《GTA6》在11月发售后，整个联盟的表现都会下滑。

paragraphs.en: As for Harington specifically, he didn't say whether or not he will actually end up playing GTA 6 or not. He's had some experience in the gaming world, as he was the main antagonist in Call of Duty: Infinite Warfare and voiced Jon Snow in Telltale's Game of Thrones video game. His next big role will be playing Gildroy Lockhart in HBO's Harry Potter TV series, which may explain why he recently dabbled in Hogwarts Legacy.
paragraphs.cn: 至于Harington，他没有说自己最终是否真的会玩《GTA6》。他与游戏也并非毫无交集：他曾在《使命召唤：无限战争》中饰演主要反派，还为Telltale开发的《权力的游戏》游戏中的琼恩·雪诺配音。接下来，他将在HBO的《哈利·波特》电视剧中饰演吉德罗·洛哈特；这或许能解释他最近为什么玩了《霍格沃茨之遗》。
